title: The Spirit Comes
subtitle: The story of Jesus going up to heaven, a rushing wind, and the very first church

scenes.title: Forty Wonderful Days
beats: After Jesus came back to life, He stayed with His friends for forty days. He ate with them, talked with them, and showed them again and again that He was really alive!
“Stay in Jerusalem and wait,” Jesus told them. “Soon God will send you the Holy Spirit, the Helper I promised.”

scenes.title: Up to Heaven
beats: One day, on a hill outside the city, Jesus said, “You will tell everyone about Me, here in Jerusalem, and all the way to the ends of the earth!”
Then, while they watched, Jesus was lifted up into the sky, higher and higher, until a cloud hid Him from sight.
Suddenly two angels in white stood beside them. “Why are you looking up at the sky? Jesus will come back the same way you saw Him go!”

layers.hint: Tap to see Jesus go up

scenes.title: Wind and Fire
beats: Jesus’ friends waited and prayed together in a room in Jerusalem, just as He had said.
Then, on the day of a big feast called Pentecost, there came a sound from heaven like a mighty, rushing wind! It filled the whole house. Whoosh!
Little flames, like fire, came and rested over each one of them. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they began to speak in other languages!

scenes.title: Everyone Understood
beats: Jerusalem was full of visitors from many different countries. When they heard the noise, a big crowd came running to see what was happening.
Jesus’ friends were telling everyone about the wonderful things God had done, and every single person heard it in their very own language! “How can this be?” they said. “They’re all from Galilee!”

scenes.title: The First Church
beats: Peter told the crowd all about Jesus, and how He died and rose again so everyone could be forgiven. That very day, about three thousand people believed and were baptized!
The new believers met together every day. They prayed, they learned about Jesus, they shared their food and everything they had, and they praised God with glad hearts.
This was the very first church! And every day, more and more people came to know Jesus. The good news was beginning to spread all over the world.

questions: The Holy Spirit came like a rushing wind and little flames of fire. What do you think that was like?
Jesus’ friends told everyone about Him. Who could you tell about Jesus?
The first church shared everything they had. What is something you could share?

verse.text: You will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you, and you will be My witnesses.
